name: Kamo. G
tagline: South African artist • Son of Moses
shortBio: Kamo. G is a Pretoria-born South African artist whose work draws on hip-hop, Afro-influenced sounds and personal storytelling.
bio: Born in Pretoria and raised in Kempton Park, Kamo. G grew up in a musical family where gospel, hip-hop, Afrobeat and kwaito were part of everyday life.
He discovered music at age nine and committed to pursuing it at sixteen. His work is grounded in identity, family and the realities of South African life.
Son of Moses is an artistic identity and campaign concept rooted in family legacy. It honours his father, Moses, and frames a continuing story of purpose, growth and self-definition.
OXYGEN TANK, released in 2023, is available on Kamo. G's official Spotify profile.
